analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 21.1 to 37.5, exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram also improved from -3.8265 to -0.6757, signaling easing weakness. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, opening potential for a technical bounce. Weekly ADX at 47.9 indicates a strong trend, but -DI is still above +DI, showing downward pressure. However, the oversold exit signal on the daily chart is prioritized for a buy entry.
